description: The bar chart illustrates a "Runtime Comparison of Models in Streaming Environment." The horizontal axis displays the categorical variables, which are specific models ordered from left to right as "Our Joint Framework," "ChatGPT," "DeepSeek," "LLaMA," and "Claude," with the labels slightly rotated. The vertical axis is labeled "Runtime (seconds)" and uses a linear scale ranging from 0 to 400, with numeric tick marks spaced at regular intervals of 50. A legend in the upper left corner specifies that dark green denotes "Our Joint Framework" and light blue denotes "LLM Models." There are five vertical bars, each outlined in black and annotated with its exact numerical value in bold text directly above it. The first bar, "Our Joint Framework," is dark green and represents the shortest runtime at 77 seconds. The subsequent four bars are light blue, representing the LLM models: "ChatGPT" has a value of 190, "DeepSeek" is the tallest bar at 365, "LLaMA" is 172, and "Claude" is 243. The bars are not sorted alphabetically or by numerical value. Visual emphasis is applied through the distinct color coding of the first bar, the black outlines on all bars, and the bold data labels, all set against a light textured background with horizontal dashed grid lines.
